title: Conflict: between people, between teams, and with product

videos.script: In a planning meeting, Paula says that some people find it hard to let go of their code. Diego leaves early. {{title}} Each of them comes to Renata that afternoon, certain the other is the problem. Both are partly right. {{both}} Underneath is a question about the work. A failure mode only Diego knows about, in a service Paula now owns. {{task}} This lesson is about finding that question. Between two people on the team. {{people}} Between Agenda and Payments, where both sides are defending legitimate goals, and escalating together beats escalating alone. {{teams}} And with product, where the habit to learn is to argue fully, and then commit fully once the decision is made. {{commit}}
